systems.platform: broadband to government facilities and community Wi-Fi hotspots
systems.owner: Department of Communications and Digital Technologies, with state-owned entities; R3 billion for phase two and R888.8 million over the medium term for maintenance
systems.tiers: phase one: about 970 government facilities (schools, health facilities, government offices, Thusong Service Centres, post offices) in eight rural district municipalities, 948 kept connected annually; phase two: 6,343 government facilities and 32,055 hotspots covering an estimated 5.6 million households

note: News quoting the 2026 Budget Review on SA Connect: the facilities connected are schools, health facilities, government offices, service centres and post offices located in eight rural district municipalities, and none is said to be a municipal office, so no connection of a local government office is stated.
